Risk officer read: I'd refuse this one. Class is labeled ORGANIC, but the 40% bundle share on the curve, a launch bot in the first two minutes, and a sell-to-buy ratio above 1 post-graduation all point to coordinated flow. The coin is also down 72% from its 30-minute high with net flow barely positive over the last 15 minutes, and the 63 SOL pool is thin enough that a $20 round trip could lose 5% or more to impact alone. No ticket size clears that bar.

If the desk overrides, the cap is $5, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, and only if pool depth and sell pressure both improve. I would not go higher under any scenario here.
memos.scout:
The strongest case for buying is the "organic" label and the curve data. Bundle share on the curve is 40%, but the top-3 holder share is only 9.7%, and the completer share of 28% suggests many distinct wallets, not one operator. In the first two minutes after graduation, 177 non-agent buyers put in about 91 SOL, and the top-5 buyer share was 13.6%, so no single wallet dominated early flow. Over the last 15 minutes, buy SOL (55.1) exceeded sell SOL (51.6), net flow was positive at +3.5 SOL, and price returned +7.3%, with 108 buyers still active. There is no airdrop-dump flag.

The case is weak, though. The 30-minute return is -45.6% and the drawdown from the high is 72%, so most of the early demand has already left. The last-15-minute net flow is small relative to a 63 SOL pool, and sellers (124) still outnumber nothing by much. The 7% bounce could be a dead-cat move. With the coin at 30 minutes, a 72% drawdown, and base rates of roughly -20% for this window, I don't see a demand case strong enough to expect buyers to persist for the next 30-60 minutes. My honest recommendation is to skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss path is distribution into the bounce. The coin is down 72% from its 30-minute high (drawdown_from_30_min_high 0.7215) and -46% over 30 minutes, yet the last 15 minutes show a +7.3% return on net flow of only +3.51 SOL. That bounce is thin: sell_sol 51.55 against buy_sol 55.06, with 124 sellers versus 108 buyers, and the sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 1.19. Holders are exiting into demand, not accumulating. The curve is also heavy: bundle_share 0.40 and a launch bot present suggest coordinated early supply. With only 63 SOL of pool depth, a $20 ticket faces a round trip of several percent in fees and impact, so even a modest fade of the bounce wipes out the gain. I'd skip.
